name: Glockenspiel
author: Versilian Studios (VCSL) / packaged for DAW
attribution: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL) by Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner, CC0 1.0
desc: Orchestral glockenspiel (metal bars), 3 velocity layers soft/medium/loud, sparkling bell tone with natural ring. Sounds G5-C8 (MIDI 79-108, playable C5-C8). Doubling melodies an octave up, bell hooks, lo-fi/hip-hop and pop sparkle, Christmas/film/cinematic. | Playable MIDI 72-108 (C5-C8), 3 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity).
